Created By : miruku_sora2026
File name : NOTICE.txt
Description : Provenance and offline reproduction instructions for Aevix's Unicode 17 property artifact.

Unicode Character Database 17.0.0
https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/UCD.zip
Original archive SHA-256:
2066d1909b2ea93916ce092da1c0ee4808ea3ef8407c94b4f14f5b7eb263d28e

The 22 .txt data files listed in manifest.json are byte-for-byte extracts
from that official archive. Their original copyright and attribution are
preserved. LICENSE-UNICODE.txt contains the complete pinned Unicode License
V3 text downloaded from https://www.unicode.org/license.txt. No project source
banner has been inserted into these upstream data or license files.

Copyright in Unicode data belongs to Unicode, Inc. The Unicode License V3
notice accompanies this directory and must accompany redistributed data or
substantial derived portions. Aevix's implementation source is otherwise
covered by the repository's Apache-2.0 license.

Offline regeneration:
    python3 tools/unicode/generate_ucd
Offline byte-for-byte verification:
    python3 tools/unicode/generate_ucd --verify
Optional comparison with a separately downloaded original archive:
    python3 tools/unicode/generate_ucd --verify --verify-upstream-archive /path/to/UCD.zip

Regular generation and CTest never fetch data from the network. The manifest
pins original file hashes, the full archive hash, complete license bytes,
generator content, packed table hashes, and semantic policy. The exported
unicode.ucd_fingerprint() is the SHA-256 of that canonical artifact manifest
before adding its own fingerprint field.

The Unicode version is a data profile rather than a claim that Aevix contains
whole-string normalization, segmentation, bidi reordering, shaping, layout,
or terminal-width algorithms. Break APIs expose the corresponding properties.
